description: How many weeks an item's available stock takes to clear under pricing moves, and which to pick: hold the price (the demand forecast), mark it down (default 15%; demand change from this workspace's own measured price response — a qualified markdown outcome on the item, else past price cuts — and status no_measured_response with no weeks when nothing was measured), and bundle it with the item most often bought on the same orders (an estimate: partner units a day × the share of the partner's orders that already include this item; status no_bundle_partner below 5 shared orders in 180 days). Each scenario has weeks to clear (">52" when it does not clear within 52 weeks), unit and gross margin, and its basis; recommendedKey is the fastest clearance that keeps a unit margin of at least zero. Quote the numbers and their basis; never invent a scenario or a number the response does not carry. deepLink opens the scenarios in Spark. Read-only.

markdownPercents.description: Optional comma-separated markdown percentages to model, at most 3, each 1-90 (default 15).

warehouseId.description: Optional warehouse id (GUID) to read stock for; omit for every warehouse.
